name: Juniper Square
positioning: Investor relations for private real estate funds — the capital account, the distribution and the portal in one place.
description: Juniper Square provides fund administration and investor management for private real estate: subscriptions and onboarding, capital calls and distributions, waterfall calculations, investor reporting and an LP portal, with an administration service option.
real_estate_use: A sponsor raising from private investors has to track ownership across entities, calculate a promote correctly, and produce K-1 packages and quarterly reports that LPs trust. Getting that wrong is a relationship problem, not a bookkeeping one. Juniper Square replaces the spreadsheet-and-mail-merge approach with an auditable system and a portal LPs log into.
features: Investor onboarding with electronic subscription documents
Capital calls, distributions and capital account tracking
LP portal with documents, statements and tax packages

use_cases.job: Run capital calls and distributions across many entities without spreadsheet risk
Give private investors a portal with their statements and tax documents
